title: UnlockSMP
description: The UnlockSMP is a vanilla+ economy Minecraft server!
body:
The **UnlockSMP** is a Minecraft Server where you try to become the richest player by getting loot and by fighting others and building farms. The IP for Java and Bedrock Edition is **play.unlocksmp.net**. It is new so you can help shape the server!
